decisionsTitle: «Doar anumiți participanți»: the organizers' message to people ticked by name — a trial before everybody, the words kept for the next press (amending §364)
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-11-13**, with a picture of «Trimite un mesaj participanților» for a race eight days away — 184 recipients, «Cere reconfirmarea» and «Trimite și numărul de concurs și codul QR» both ticked: «As vrea sa fac un test pentru mailul asta, sa selectez doar anumiti participanti».

**What was missing.** §364 offers four groups, read from the registrations' states. The smallest of them is still everybody in a state, so the first time anybody saw a message in a real mailbox was when everybody did. The preview cannot stand in for that: it is addressed to a made-up runner, whose QR picture's address answers nothing (§943), and it says nothing of how the message arrives in a mail client on a phone.

**Decision.**

1. **A fifth choice of «Cui îi trimiți»: «Doar anumiți participanți, pe care îi aleg din listă».** It stands beside the four groups and is not one of them (`CHOSEN_AUDIENCE`): `PARTICIPANT_MESSAGE_AUDIENCES` and `AUDIENCE_STATUSES` are unchanged, and the three parts still partition the first. Under its radio the composer lists the event's active registrations — the states the widest group holds, a test registration marked as one — by name as Romanian sorts it, each with its state in the backoffice's own word and a tick. A box finds a name with case, diacritics and the order of its words forgiven (`foldName`), and Enter in it finds and never sends the form. A name and a state, and nothing else of a person: no address and no number, which is what the race-day desk shows of somebody. The roles that reach the page read the registrations anyway (§364.7).
2. **The page says who before the press; the question says how many.** Under the list: «Primesc mesajul: Ana Popescu, …», the ticks a search hides included. Where each group says its number: «Bifați: 2 din 184». «Trimite mesajul» waits for one tick. The ticks exist only in the browser, so the question's title names no number — «Trimiți mesajul doar participanților bifați?» — and its bold line counts them at the press: «Pleacă 2 emailuri „Mesaj de la organizatori”, câte unul către fiecare participant.», with the club's one copy of the send, a test registration's tick counting nobody (`AGENTS.md` §12.6). That is a third way for the dialog to count (`EmailCount.ticks`) beside the two §384 has: a series' dates and a bulk cancel's rows are counted per value, each its own send, and would have said one club copy per person. No cost, deferral or pace line is drawn for this choice: none can be worded on the server for a list ticked in the browser, and the outbox defers what an allowance cannot carry, as for any send (§40).
3. **The send is the group's send, narrowed.** `sendParticipantMessage` reads the widest group's rows under the event's lock exactly as it did, and keeps those whose registration is ticked. So the choice can only narrow: a tick on a registration cancelled since the page was drawn, lapsed, with an address nobody confirmed, of another event, or on no registration at all, writes to nobody — and a posted list of any length is never a statement's parameters. Everything else is as it was: one row a registration, in its language, keyed by the send; `askReconfirm` and `sendQr` each on its own rows; the club's one copy with the count of real people; test rows counted apart; a second press of the same form queueing nothing. A press that leaves nobody to write to is refused on the list itself, in a sentence of its own (`NO_CHOSEN_RECIPIENTS`), every box and tick kept (§315). A send to a group ignores any tick posted with it.
4. **The audit row says the choice, never who.** `audience: "CHOSEN"`, the counts and the subject, as §364.8 has it for a group — no registration's id and no address. «Mesaje trimise» names such a send «Participanți aleși». Who was written to stays where it is for every send: on the outbox rows, for as long as those are kept.
5. **After such a send the words stay in the boxes — and after no other.** A trial is followed by the same message to everybody, and §364.6 empties the boxes after a send, which would have had the organizer type four boxes in two languages a second time, with nothing to check them against. So the redirect of a send to the people ticked carries the send's own id (`?kept=`, a uuid that names a send and nobody), and the page reads that send's words back into the boxes and its two ticks back onto theirs (`readKeptMessage`): the words from the payload of one of the send's own outbox rows — the one text an outbox row keeps (§364.11) — and the ticks from its audit row. Nothing new is stored. The radio is back on the page's default and the form has a new id, so the next press is a new send; the alert says the text was kept, and that those ticked get it again if they are in the group chosen next. A send to a group lands on empty boxes as it always did, and an id that names a group's send, another event's or no send reads back nothing.

**Rejected.**
- **«Trimite-mi mie o probă» — the message to the organizer's own staff address.** It would show the words and miss what a trial is for: the recipient's own number, QR and desk code, which nobody else's mailbox may hold (§320); «Vin» on a real link; the registrant's own language. An organizer who is registered ticks their own name.
- **Ticking people on the registrations list and carrying the selection to the composer.** That list's ticks belong to its own bulk form, and a selection would have to cross two pages in an address (`AGENTS.md` §14.5 forbids it) or in a store. The composer is where «Cui îi trimiți» is asked.
- **Recording who was ticked in the audit row.** §364.8 keeps recipients out of the trail, and a short list of ids is a list of people.
- **Addresses or race numbers on the list.** Neither is needed to find somebody by name, and the list is drawn with every visit to the page.
- **Keeping the words after every send, or a «use this text again» on «Mesaje trimise».** §364.6 stands for a send to a group: after one, the next press must not be the last message again. Reusing an older text is another ask, and it was not made.
- **Leaving the trial's recipients out of the send that follows.** A message to «everybody» that skips three people would have to say so on every screen that counts it; the alert says instead that they get it again.
- **A typed list of addresses.** It would write to an address that holds no active registration, which §364.2 refuses.

**Not done.** Without JavaScript the list never opens — it is the island's state — and a press of that choice is refused for having nobody ticked; the four groups send as before. The list is every active registration of the event, drawn with the page: right for a club's race of a few hundred, and to be paged should an event ever hold thousands.
changelogLine: - **«Doar anumiți participanți» on «Trimite un mesaj participanților»** — a fifth choice under «Cui îi trimiți»: tick people by name from the event's registrations and the message goes only to them, for a trial before everybody gets it. The page says who is ticked and the question counts them. After such a send the text and the two ticks stay in the boxes, so the same message goes to everybody with one more press. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Amends criterion 24. Given the composer, then «Cui îi trimiți» offers a fifth choice beside the four groups, «Doar anumiți participanți, pe care îi aleg din listă»: under it the event's registrations in a state the widest group holds — a cancelled, expired or `PENDING_EMAIL_CONFIRMATION` one never among them, a test one marked — by name in Romanian order, each with its state and a tick and nothing else of the person (no address, no number); a box finds a name with case, diacritics and the order of its words forgiven, and Enter in it sends nothing; the page says the names ticked and «Bifați: N din M», «Trimite mesajul» waits for a tick, and the question's email line counts the ticks at the press — a test registration's counting nobody — with the club's one copy of the send (2026-11-13, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given a send to the people ticked, then one ORGANIZER_MESSAGE is queued for exactly the ticked registrations that are of this event and in a state the widest group holds when the send reads them under the event row's lock — a tick on a cancelled, lapsed or unconfirmed-address registration, on another event's or on no registration writes to nobody — with everything else as criterion 11 has it for a group: the registration's language, each flag on its own rows, the club's one copy with the count of real people, test rows apart, a second press queueing nothing. A send to a group ignores any tick posted with it. A press that leaves nobody to write to queues and audits nothing and is refused on the list (`NO_CHOSEN_RECIPIENTS`) with every box and tick kept. The audit row says `audience: "CHOSEN"`, the counts and the subject, never a registration's id or an address, and «Mesaje trimise» names the send «Participanți aleși» (2026-11-13, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given a send to the people ticked that queued, then the page it returns to carries that send's id, its boxes hold that send's subject and body in both languages and its two ticks — read from one of the send's own outbox rows and from its audit row, nothing new stored — under a new form id with the page's default group chosen, and the alert says the text was kept; after a send to a group, for an id that names a group's send, another event's or no send, and once the send's outbox rows are gone, the boxes are empty (2026-11-13, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given a Tehnic, a Redactor or a Voluntar, when a send to the people ticked is posted, then the server refuses it with FORBIDDEN whoever is ticked, and nothing is queued (2026-11-13, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

batchLine: the organizers' message to people ticked by name, for a trial before everybody
